info.name: Gurukul (Supabase)
info.description:
Every backend call the Gurukul app makes, straight to Supabase: Auth (/auth/v1), tables and RPCs (/rest/v1), Storage (/storage/v1).

Start: pick the **Gurukul** environment, fill in its Current values, then run **1. Auth → Log in as …**. See frontend/postman/README.md.

Generated by frontend/postman/build-collection.mjs. Edit that file, not this JSON.

item.name: Add a YouTube link as the lesson video

request.description: One video per lesson: a second call fails with a unique violation (409).
Storage paths under a course (optionally one module or lesson). The app calls this before deleting so it can clean up the files.

exec: if (pm.response.code < 300 && json !== null) { const value = (pm.environment.get('supabase_url') + '/storage/v1' + json.signedURL); if (value !== undefined && value !== null && value !== false) pm.environment.set("signed_url", value); }

request.description: Only works for users who may read the lesson (enrolled, owner, admin, or preview lessons).
Deletes the media row and returns its storage path. Then delete the file itself (next request).
Changing p_owner_id transfers the course (the new owner becomes an instructor and gets access).

item.name: 8. ⚠ Admin danger zone (permanent)
item.description: Irreversible deletes. Kept apart so a collection run never reaches them by accident.

request.description: Permanent. Cascades modules, lessons, media rows, enrollments and progress. Files in Storage are NOT removed; use 'Get media paths' first.

item.description: Each request is expected to FAIL; its test passes when Supabase refuses it. Needs a course_id owned by someone other than the learner.

item.name: 10. Flow: course end to end (Collection Runner)
item.description: Run this folder with the Collection Runner. Instructor creates a course → admin approves → learner enrols, completes a lesson and 'watches' → instructor reads the analytics → admin deletes the test course.
